text.tspan: Annual rate of people affected by all natural disasters World, 2000 to 2025
The total number of people affected is the sum of those injured, requiring assistance, and left homeless. Rates
are measured per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires,

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
